title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - Orientation
description: Orientation (era:Orientation's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents the orientation of a railway object in relation to a carrier linear element. It can be described by direction, orientation and side.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Orientation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

carrierLinearElement.description: Relationship. The carrier linear element in relation to which the orientation is based on

direction.description: Property. The direction of the orientation of a railway element, in relation to the carrier linear element Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Directions of the orientation of a railway element' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/orientations/OrientationDirections), 3 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

side.description: Property. Indication of the position of the signal in relation to the track in the running direction from the origin of the referencing system (e.g., direction of the main line) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Sides' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/orientations/Sides), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.
